commit.description: Auto-detect changes, bump version, update changelog, commit, and push
commit.template:
Detect what changed since the last commit, generate a commit message, increment the version, update CHANGELOG.md, stage, commit, and push. Steps:
1. Run `git status` and `git diff --stat` to identify ALL changes (modified, new, deleted files)
2. Look at the actual diff (`git diff` and `git diff --cached`) to understand WHAT changed
3. Generate a CONCISE commit message (1 line, max 80 chars) summarizing the changes in Spanish. Format: short description of what was added/fixed/changed. Do NOT prefix with vX.YY – that will be added automatically
4. Get today's date: Get-Date -Format 'yyyy-MM-dd'
5. Read telegram_listener.py, find the current version (pattern: vDD.DD in the banner)
6. Parse vMAJOR.MINOR, increment MINOR by 1, form new version string (e.g., v0.13 → v0.14)
7. Replace the old version with the new version in telegram_listener.py using edit tool
8. Prepend a new entry to CHANGELOG.md right after `# Changelog — TelBot`:
   `## vX.YY — YYYY-MM-DD`
   `- <generated commit message>`
   (blank line after)
9. Stage all: git add -A
10. Commit: git commit -m "vX.YY: <generated commit message>"
11. Push: git push
12. Report the new version with the commit message.
RULES:
- NEVER ask the user for a commit message. Generate it yourself from the diffs
- Commit message must be in Spanish, 1 line, concise
- If no changes to commit, report it and stop
- Do NOT use git tags
- Bump version and update changelog BEFORE staging
